messages:
mira (product): Quick triage: BetaHealth wants a scoped Optimize alpha for their pilot in 4 weeks. Requirements: tenant-aware quant recommendations, nightly eval-triggered alerts on a curated clinical prompt set, audit records, and explicit opt-out (no auto-rollouts). Can we commit to an API-only alpha?

sam (swe): API-only + Dedicated region target sounds doable. Reuse eval-runner + alert pipeline. Estimate: ~2 sprints for a small team. No UI for alpha.

nina (ml): ML plan: sample ~1k clinical prompts, run baseline + quant candidates, score by clinical entity F1 and ppl, then surface top-2 quant profiles with estimated p50/p95/p99 latency and cost delta.

leo (solutions): Customer compliance needs a persisted audit entry for each recommendation: baseline_eval_id, new_eval_id, recommended_quant, metric_deltas, and a short rationale. Also they require an opt-out flag.

sam (swe): Alert flow: nightly eval -> comparator -> if trigger -> emit JSON alert -> deliver to internal ops channel + customer webhook + email. Target delivery <10m. We'll add a tenant config to disable delivery.

nina (ml): Proposed triggers: entity F1 drop >= 2% absolute OR perplexity up >=8% with latency win >=20% -> produce recommendation. Payload includes 2-3 sentence rationale.

mira (product): Acceptance criteria for alpha: nightly evals saved and queryable; alerts emitted <10m and delivered to three endpoints; audit record stored with required fields; opt-out respected; docs + one-page runbook.

leo (solutions): I'll draft customer-facing advisory wording clarifying "advisory-only" and opt-out semantics.

sam (swe): Eng sign-off provided we keep it API-only. Will open ticket today with acceptance criteria.

ci-bot: Branch created: feature/optimize-betahealth-alpha. CI started.

mira (product): If no objections, we lock alpha scope: API-only recommendations, nightly eval-triggered alerts, audit logs, opt-out. React with :white_check_mark: / :x: in thread.
note: Per agents.md do not include a title field
